paragraphs: R' Ananiel bar Shashon. Mentioned in Shemot Rabbah 3:6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ש״ר פ״ג-ו is expanded as Shemot Rabbah, chapter 3, section 6, following the connected citation reading. Shashon preserves the current conventional vocalization of ששון; the earlier reviewer suggested Sasson. The unpointed spelling alone does not settle those vowels. The abbreviated title remains R'.
The supplied locator ש״ר פ״ג-ו is conventionally rendered Shemot Rabbah 3:6; the occurrence and this edition’s numbering have not been independently checked.
